verdict.rationale: A government tax service could plausibly offer a conversational or natural-language way to operate accounts, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows web forms, the business tax account, the HMRC app and a REST API that MTD-compatible software uses. 'Ask HMRC online' is just a link title with no indication it can carry out actions, and 'agent' in the sign-up docs means human tax agents, not AI agents. No evidence shows users can operate HMRC services with natural-language commands.
